notes.hook: time-span claim in the title ('My 5 years of natural bodybuilding') carried by a progress montage
notes.what_goes_wrong: No spoken or visible starting number in the transcript; an exact year-1 vs year-5 figure would make the jump undeniable.
notes.reusable_pattern: A time-span progress montage on an epic song; the years do the storytelling, no talking needed.
